name: T PLANK RIGHT
introduce:
Start in straight-arm plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders.

Rotate your upper body, and extend your right arm straight up towards the sky, so your body looks like a letter “T”.

Return to the starting position, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Contract your abs while rotating your body.
This exercise helps to improve your balance and stability.
It's a good exercise for your core muscles.
It’s a good exercise for your deltoids.
